OnlineCourseFaq1.subtitle: FAQ
OnlineCourseFaq1.description: Find answers to commonly asked questions about our courses, enrollment process, payments, certificates, and more.

faqs.question: What courses are available?
faqs.answer: We offer career-focused courses in web development, data science, digital marketing, design, and business skills.

faqs.question: Are the courses self-paced?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lessons are available online so you can learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

faqs.question: Do I receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive a certificate after completing the course requirements.

faqs.question: Can I contact an instructor?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our support team can connect you with the appropriate instructor or course guidance.

faqs.question: How do I enroll?
faqs.answer: Choose a course, open its details page, and submit the enrollment form to get started.
